related_titles_screened.title: Slice rank of tensor subspaces over any field is bounded by (d/2+1) times its rank over the algebraic closure
Trilinear slice rank is at most five times analytic rank plus a logarithmic term, with slice forms obtained by fixing coordinates
Exact subadditivity of analytic rank for finite-field multilinear tensors
Over every finite field other than F2, the slice, geometric and analytic ranks of a three-tensor satisfy SR at most three GR at most 8.13 AR
The geometric rank of an integer three-tensor equals the lower limit of the analytic ranks of its reductions over prime fields as the prime tends to infinity
Tensor analytic rank remains comparable under arbitrary finite extensions of a fixed finite field
Order-d tensors over any finite field with analytic rank at most r, r at least one, have partition rank bounded by a polynomial in r whose exponent depends only on d

independence: Only original Theorem 1 in its historical finite-field scope excluding F\_2 is selected: SR(T)<=3 GR(T)<=8.13 AR(T) for every three-tensor. The broader perfect-field first inequality is retained as original context, not separately counted. Original full rank definitions, Sections 2--4, common tangent slice decomposition, linear-section induction, exact base-field descent invocation, full generalized Schwartz-Zippel proof and final character-average/rank closing are included. Ordinary prerequisites are Harris/Shafarevich tangent and dimension basics; Bruns--Vetter Theorem 2.10 and Nullstellensatz for determinantal ideals; Derksen [11, Theorem 2.5, Corollary 3.7 and Proposition 4.9] stable-rank descent over perfect fields (the complete authored combination and explicitly titled proof sketch are retained); Kopparty--Moshkovitz--Zuiddam [30, Theorem 3.1 and Lemma 4.2] geometric-rank fibre characterization/invariance; overdetermined Bezout as [39, Theorem 5]; Bukh--Tsimerman [6, Lemma 14]/Dvir--Kollar--Lovett [13, Claim 7.2] point-degree bound; and Kollar [29, Theorem 1.5] generic-combination complete-intersection envelope. No source-local new argument is treated as an external prerequisite. Authored literal fields in the P,Q paragraph at 406 and minor-product display at 421, and the tensor-space V\_2 membership footnote at 172 are preserved without a mathematical verdict or repair.
